name: Gerald Hines
headline: Co-Owner and founder @ 8QUANTA | NetSuite Foundations certified
about:
At 8QUANTA, our team specializes in crafting bespoke NetSuite solutions that elevate operational efficiency and financial clarity for our clients. With a profound understanding of ERP systems, we have pioneered unique offerings like 8Q Payments and signature capture technologies, directly addressing the nuanced needs within finance and inventory management sectors.

The ethos driving our consultancy hinges on inspired vision, integrity, and meaningful innovation. Our commitment to fostering healthy relationships has been paramount in delivering superior solutions that not only streamline processes but also empower our clients to harness the full potential of their NetSuite investment. Through collaboration, we transform complex business challenges into opportunities for growth and optimization.
… more

experiences.description:
8QUANTA is an integrative software developer and consulting group that supports NetSuite users to maximize the potential of their NetSuite investment.  Founded by Gerald and Ilona Hines in 2016, the company offers exclusive NetSuite custom solutions consisting of credit cards and ACH processing (8Q Payments), NetSuite payment auto reconciliation with bank feeds, pay links on Sales Orders (For deposits), Invoices and Statements (For payments of single or multiple invoices), 8Q signature capture (inside NetSuite and remote signature capture on documents), Estimated landed Cost solution with Auto Reconciliation (Inventory and Supply chain) Shipping Profitability Center (Inventory and Supply Chain).  

8QUANTA’s products are suited for a variety of industries, such as Manufacturing and Distribution, Wholesale, Retail, Food and Beverage, Nonprofit and Healthcare, and e-Commerce digital storefronts.  8QUANTA is one of the three companies in the world that has both a NetSuite Alliance and a SuiteCloud Developer Network Partnership with Oracle NetSuite. This unique position has allowed 8QUANTA to support major brands such as SellMark Industries, Premier Nutrition, Daystar Television Network, DocuSign, Bulletproof, Park Hill Collection, Magnolia Market, The Décor Group, Sorrento Technologies, Allstate Floral, MISA Imports, SOCI, StaffPro, and many more.
